body:
jamie.releases: Deploy bot shows quiet window starts in 15m at 22:00 UTC. We need final confirmations for staggered traffic shift and rollback cadence. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Quiet window scheduled for 2023-11-11T22:00:00Z. Canary cohort: 1%. Traffic shift plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m with health gates.

alice.eng: can confirm canary pin ready: `v2.3.1-canary-20231111`. Load test passed on 90th pct latency, mem ok. :thumbsup:

tom.sre: monitoring alerts and synthetic checks are green. Will watch during shifts. Putting ETA on-call at 22:00-23:00.

priya.product: final QA smoke checklist done except one minor UI timing flake (non-blocking). We agreed to monitor but not hold launch.

ben.docs: release notes are up at https://confluence.redwood/release/2.3.1 - added the migration caveat in the DB section.

sara.db: DB migration (deferred index build) will run in background. No exclusive lock expected. We will pause if DML latency > 150ms for 5m.

jamie.releases: Nice. For rollback policy: if error rate > 2% or any P1 within first 20m, we roll to `v2.3.0` and cut traffic to 0% for canary. Confirmed?

alice.eng: agree with thresholds. Also add token-cost spike check — if token throughput CPU > 85% for 10m, auto-fallback to quantized variant `v2.3.1-q4` and throttle requests.

oncall-bot: [Oncall] Added incident channel #incidents to alert routing, escalation to tom.sre and jamie.releases.

jamie.releases: Operational checklist before quiet window (quick read):
- push canary pin `deployctl pin --service inference --version v2.3.1-canary`
- enable staged traffic policy `trafficctl set --policy staggered-30m`
- ensure KV cache warming enabled
- open rollback runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/rollback-v2.3

alice.eng: I'm going to run the pin in 10m and post logs here.

ben.docs: tiny ask — add a one-liner in the release note about the fallback to `v2.3.1-q4` so support can triage quickly.

sara.db: one more note: if migration causes increased tail latency, we will hold traffic shift until it's within < 100ms 95th.

jamie.releases: copy. Final go/no-go at T-5 and then we'll start canary at T+0. If anyone cannot attend the watch, say now.

priya.product: I'll be on watch for product regressions.

tom.sre: staying on watch.

alice.eng: pin applied: `deployctl pin --service inference --version v2.3.1-canary`
```
2023-11-11T21:50:12Z INFO pin applied inference:v2.3.1-canary
2023-11-11T21:50:13Z INFO canary route created cohort=1% target=canary
```

jamie.releases: thanks. Starting canary in 5.

(At 22:02) deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Traffic shift step 1 -> 10% started. Health gate in 5m.

tom.sre: first gate passed. no errors, cpu 72%, token throughput steady.

(At 22:12) deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Traffic shift step 2 -> 50% started.

alice.eng: smoke tests still good. No regressions on the prompt pipelines.

(At 22:28) oncall-bot: [Oncall] Observability spike: embedding queue latency spiked to 220ms for 3m — below our 5m threshold. Continuing to monitor.

jamie.releases: Holding shift to 100% until embedding latency stabilizes < 150ms 95th for 10m. Triggering extended watch.

priya.product: noted. Updating stakeholders and delaying final release note broadcast by 15m.

ben.docs: updated release note with fallback mention and a short troubleshooting table.

(At 22:45) tom.sre: embedding latency recovered. All gates green. Ready for final step when jamie gives go.

jamie.releases: Go for final traffic shift to 100%. If any P1 or error rate > 2% in next 20m, we roll back to v2.3.0.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Traffic shift step 3 -> 100% started.

(At 23:05) alice.eng: All good in canary and ramp. No increased errors, perf within expected. Closing quiet window watch and marking release as live. :tada:

jamie.releases: Thanks team — postmortem/ops notes will be added to the runbook. If anyone sees lingering issues, report in #incidents.

sara.db: migration finished successfully. No rollback needed.

ben.docs: publishing release announcement now.

jamie.releases: Nice job everyone.
